sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a production animation atlas for a bright Minecraft-style monster-collecting quest book. One SQUARE transparent image containing EXACTLY SIXTEEN sprites arranged in a perfectly regular FOUR-COLUMN by FOUR-ROW grid. Every row is a DIFFERENT quest item design; within that row the four cells are the SAME design in four consecutive restrained animation frames. Read each row left to right (A, B, C, D), then the next row below. Equal invisible cells. Centers at coordinates 12.5%, 37.5%, 62.5%, 87.5% on both axes. Render each subject only once per cell, centered and complete, within the middle 65–70% of that cell. Leave clear transparent space on ALL FOUR sides of EVERY sprite. Do not draw grid lines, panel edges, sheets of paper, captions, text, numbers, labels, floating background dots, glow haze, or a checkerboard. No other art anywhere. GENUINE transparent alpha. Pixel style: each icon reads like an original hand-placed 32x32 low-resolution game sprite with chunky logical pixel stair steps, thick crisp midnight-navy outlines, simple clear silhouettes and a shared small set of 8–12 flat opaque colors for all 4 frames of a row. Rendered enlarged with square nearest-neighbor hard edges, zero antialias, no gradients or diffuse light. Fixed scale, angle, shape, centered baseline and placement in each row. Each row must show at least two unmistakably different animation states even at 24 pixels. Move only the described bright internal clusters or very small parts. Do not change designs between columns, do not exchange rows and columns. Original art from scratch. No official sprites, other artists' work or generic book icons.

FOUR ROWS, from TOP to BOTTOM:
ROW 1 — An unbroken cream egg with a single tiny leaf and a tall gold champion crown above it, maximum level while unevolved. In all four columns keep this same motif. Four successive motion states: An ivory glint rolls across the unbroken eggshell while the crown stays fixed.
ROW 2 — One bright cyan four-point shiny sparkle above a red-and-ivory capture ball, a first shiny catch. In all four columns keep this same motif. Four successive motion states: The small centered sparkle opens from a cross to a four-point star and closes.
ROW 3 — A violet capture ball surrounded by a crown of five gold star-shaped sparkles, five shiny catches. In all four columns keep this same motif. Four successive motion states: The gold glint moves between the stars while the ball stays fixed.
ROW 4 — A compact curved red fishing rod with a red-and-white ball bobber and one blue fish breaking a cyan ripple. In all four columns keep this same motif. Four successive motion states: The round bobber bobs one logical pixel, then the fish's blue tail flicks and settles.

Final check: 4 columns and 4 rows, exactly 16 complete cutout icons; each row repeats its own item through four subtly different frames; uniform transparent margins and no writing.

rows.subject: An unbroken cream egg with a single tiny leaf and a tall gold champion crown above it, maximum level while unevolved.

rows.subject: One bright cyan four-point shiny sparkle above a red-and-ivory capture ball, a first shiny catch.

rows.title: Shiny Hunter
rows.subject: A violet capture ball surrounded by a crown of five gold star-shaped sparkles, five shiny catches.

rows.title: Angler
rows.subject: A compact curved red fishing rod with a red-and-white ball bobber and one blue fish breaking a cyan ripple.
